sentence: This project tests whether machine learning on bedside abdominal ultrasound can identify injury in children after blunt trauma without using computed tomography scans.
This project uses 4D bioprinting with living materials to build a human gut-brain axis that has epithelium and enteric nerve.
This project manages shared services that give cancer researchers laboratory analysis, study design and data analysis, including genomics and nutrition support.
This project makes genetically altered mice, including transgenic and chimeric mice, for cancer research using genome editing and embryonic stem cell injection.
This project develops silver-telluride nanoparticle contrast agents for mammography that should highlight tumors in women with dense breasts.
This project provides microscopes and small animal imaging tools to study digestive health and disease in tissue specimens and small animals.
This project uses deep learning on electrocardiogram waveform data to predict cardiac outcomes in patients on hemodialysis.
This project builds explainable deep learning methods that use imaging and electronic health record data to predict pulmonary fibrosis after COVID-19.
This project gives public access to human genome sequencing data that helps scientists and clinicians tell which changes in DNA may lead to disease.
This project studies how meningeal lymphatic vessels help the developing brain and immune system communicate in a mouse model of pediatric brain tumor.
This project builds an artificial intelligence tool that detects bladder tumors in real time during cystoscopy.
This project uses whole genome sequencing in patients to find unknown genes behind hereditary spastic paraplegia.
This project studies how stem cells compete in skin, and how winner cells sense and attack loser cells.
This project studies how microglia, a cell type in the retina, protect the retina from damage in degenerative eye diseases.
This project builds models that combine genetic risk factors with plasma proteome markers to predict a person's risk of autoimmunity before symptoms begin.
This project studies how an acetyl-CoA metabolic enzyme controls gene expression and lipid metabolism in steatotic liver disease.
This project studies how gut microbes and their metabolites affect Parkinson's disease dementia, using animal models and stem-cell models.
This project provides imaging instruments to study the retina, lens, choroid and tear film in patients and animal models of ocular disease.
This project provides bioinformatics support for analyzing genomics and proteomics data to help understand cancer biology.
